title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Who is Greene related to with the Tigers

Nobody His dad played semi-pro in Lakeland at Tigertown, it was called babe Ruth league or something. Was never officially a tiger though. Dad played college ball at Florida Tech James Orr’s daughter attends the same high school as Riley. Fangraphs blasted that out to the world a couple weeks ago.
